items.observations: Both friends are green; the held treasure map has a dotted route ending at a blue person rather than a chest. Its symbol faces the readers. Original two panels, speech text and character identities remain. Grip naturally obscures some fingers.

Actual result preserves rain, delayed bus, cast, calm-spreading gestures and Persian bubbles. Open eyes have small internal glints without white sclera. Pink has fine lashes in both panels; soft blush appears most clearly on blue/violet. Open palms and hanging hands have readable contours. Crossed hands and watch-touching fingers have natural overlap.

Actual final image has slimmer balanced arms and a straighter moderate torso, without skinny limbs. Lighter broader purple washes and head highlights are visible; some original fine texture remains for the owner to judge. Workshop, apron, clamped wood, two-handed outward chisel cut and Persian label are retained.
